name: living_wall
provenance: Schema-fill (Step 3) output captured verbatim from the live living-wall climbing run. Never hand-edited; see tests/fixtures/README.md.
notes: VerticalSurface climb: tag='Holdable' holds, a structure/Environment cliff, wall-attached hazards. The contrast case for dropzone_arcade — its player group is character/Player/count=1, so the generator's player-merge fires and the avatar spawns where the layout put it. KNOWN FAILING: objective_targets, because this capture's mission targets an entity named 'SummitView' that the fill never wrote. There is no ground truth to repair it from — no entity resembles a summit — so the check records it rather than guessing, and it is deliberately absent from must_pass. Score 90 is the floor WITH that failure; if a future change makes the schema-fill or a rescue produce the missing entity, re-lock the floor upward. FLOOR MOVED 90->88 when the custom_script_body check landed: FogBreathSystem carry no body, so each is a component attached to a live object that does nothing. The build did not get worse — a real defect that nothing measured before is now counted. Re-lock upward once Step 3.5a (unity_micro_code.enrich_scripts) authors them. KNOWN FAILING (added): objective_kinematics, since docs/COMPILER_AUDIT.md Gap D replaced the sorted-Y-only hold-chain walk with a real 3-D graph BFS (src/unity_reachability.wall_climb_reachable). WallOrganismGroup's hazard-placement spreads instances out to x=±45.479 (`_layout_vertical_surface`'s hazard clearance loop pushes a hazard away from every hold by `_HAZARD_HOLD_CLEARANCE`, with no cap tying it back to the climb's own `reach`) — the old Y-only check never looked at X and called every one of those points reachable off a shared Y alone; the new check correctly finds most of them tens of metres outside a 2.5 m climbing reach. FLOOR MOVED 88->82: the build did not get worse — a real defect (hazard-tagged objectives placed outside climbing reach) that nothing measured before is now counted. Re-lock upward once the hazard-placement loop in src/unity_layout.py is taught to keep a hazard that also carries an objective tag within `reach` of the chain, not just `_HAZARD_HOLD_CLEARANCE` away from it. entity_scene_coverage added to ungraded_ok (score unchanged): no scene_specs declared, so nothing can be orphaned — see evals/playability/cases/dropzone_arcade.json's note for what the check catches when scene_specs IS declared.
